Hi — I'm the CEO of ContractMind, an AI-powered legal tech SaaS company. My intelligence team has collected a batch of raw market signals this week and dumped them into `/workspace/intel/raw_feeds/signals_2024_07_15.json`. We also have some partial competitor notes in `/workspace/competitors/profiles/stubs.json` and our company overview in `/workspace/internal/company_context.json`.

I need you to act as our Chief Intelligence Officer and process all of this into our standard intelligence deliverables for the week. Specifically, I need three output files:

1. `weekly_intelligence_report.json` — our full weekly report covering all signals from this week.
2. `adhoc_alert.json` — an urgent alert for the single most time-sensitive signal that needs immediate attention today.
3. `daily_brief.json` — today's executive daily brief.

Please make sure you apply the proper analytical rigor: classify each signal appropriately, do full competitive profiles on LexAI and ClauseBot using all available data, evaluate the technology signals with proper scoring, and make sure the alert follows our standard alert structure. The weekly report should also reflect a proper structured evaluation of the Claude model release and what it means for our product.
